To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

Chinese RM firms are more likely to use both accrual based and earnings management through real activities manipulation than non Chinese RM and other Chinese US firms, that Chinese RM firms substitute accruals based and earnings management with real activities management over time, and that real activities manipulation is more costly than accruals manipulation in Chinese RM firms.
Chinese RM firms manipulate both real activities and financial reporting, and that accruals management is more costly than real activities management.
Chinese reverse merger firms manipulate earnings through both accruals and real activities management, and that accruals management is more costly than real activities management.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the earnings management practices of Chinese reverse merger firms and their impact on the financial reporting environment.
the question of how Chinese reverse merger firms trade off and manage earnings.
the question of how Chinese reverse merger firms manipulate earnings through real activities and accrually based earnings management.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

Chinese RM firms tend to use both accruals manipulation and real activities management to manipulate earnings and that these strategies tend to transition to a more real activities manipulation strategy in the years after the RM.
Chinese RM firms are more likely to use real activities manipulation than accrual based manipulation, and that real activities management is more likely to occur after the reverse takeover.
the Chinese RMs are not a good investment vehicle.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
Chinese reverse merger firms engage in both accrual based and cash flow manipulation to manage earnings and the two manipulation strategies tend to be substitutes.
the Chinese reverse merger market is a fertile ground for both real activities and accounting based earnings manipulation.

Chinese reverse merger firms are able to engage in both real and accrual based income increasing earnings management, but the real activities manipulation is more effective in terms of improving post acquisition operating performance.
The main takeaway from our work is that
Chinese RM firms tend to use real activities management as a back door to increase earnings.
the reverse merger process can provide a back door for Chinese firms to engage in earnings management through real activities manipulation and accrual based management.

Chinese RM firms are able to engage in both accrual and real activities based earnings manipulation and that they tend to transition to the more costly real activities management strategy in later years.
